Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for the productive demo yesterday. To keep momentum and shorten the close timeline, I sketched a short mutual action plan (MAP) and want to align on two things this week: 1) who will be the executive sponsor / business owner on your side (we typically map an EB-level sponsor + procurement contact), and 2) a 30–45 minute Executive Briefing (EB) where we present the MAP, success criteria for the eval, and finalize procurement next steps.

Proposed EB slots (PT):
- Tue 12 May, 10:30–11:15am
- Wed 13 May, 2:00–2:45pm
- Thu 14 May, 9:00–9:45am

I attached a working MAP template and a short evaluation checklist — these are drafts, happy to adjust. Can you confirm who from Interlock will fill the EB seat (VP/Head of Product or CIO-level recommended) and whether procurement should join the EB or a separate follow-up? If the slots above don't work, share 2 alternatives and we’ll coordinate.

Thanks — looking forward to locking dates.

Best,

- Procurement (procurement@interlockhealth.com) should be included in the EB for contract scope and timeline; they prefer to attend early.

On it — I uploaded a MAP with milestones and a brief SOW draft to the shared Drive and attached a cleaned MAP for Interlock (Interlock_MAP_v1.xlsx). Draft EB agenda (30 min):
- 0–5m: Introductions & EB purpose (Karthik / Priya)
- 5–15m: Success criteria & evaluation plan (Marissa)
- 15–23m: Procurement & commercial timeline (Sergio)
- 23–30m: Q&A & next steps (all)

Acceptable acceptance criteria (summary slide attached):
- Cold-start 95th percentile latency < 350ms for 256-token responses
- Cost per 1k tokens below $0.045 with caching/batching assumptions
- Data path hosted within customer VPC, SOC2 extract available
- Availability target 99.5% during eval window

SOW skeleton: high-level scope, trial length (45 days), responsibilities, exit criteria. I attached the cleaned MAP and the acceptance-criteria slide.

Proposed EB invite (to send to Interlock): Wed, 13 May 2026, 2:00–2:45pm PT — I’ll draft the invite.
